task.name: place_spoon_into_pot_cover_lid
task.description: Use thw left arm to place the green spoon into the red pot, and then use the right arm to grasp the lid and cover the pot.

substages.substage: 1. Move the left arm to approach and align with the green spoon.
2. Grasp the green spoon with the left arm.
3. Move the left arm to align with the red pot.
4. Release the gripper to place the green spoon into the red pot.
5. Move the right arm to approach and align with the lid.
6. Grasp the lid with the right arm.
7. Move the right arm to align with the red pot.
8. Release the gripper to cover the red pot with the lid.
